title: rhAmpSeq Library Prep Part 2 - Cleanup 1
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples with beads are incubated for 10 minutes
The magnetic module is engaged for 5 minutes
Remainder of ethyl alcohol is removed
Samples are air dried for 3 minutes
Magnetic module is engaged for 3 minutes

steps.title: Add AMPure beads and mix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of Agencourt AMPure XP beads to each sample on the magnetic module located in slot 1 and mix to homogenize.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑bound samples for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (first)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to collect the beads.

steps.title: Perform ethanol wash twice
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 80 % freshly prepared ethanol as described below.

steps.title: Remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove all residual ethanol from each well.

steps.title: Add IDTE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL of IDTE buffer (pH 8.0) to each sample.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (second)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 3 minutes to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 11 µL of the supernatant to the elution plate located in slot 5.

steps.title: Signal protocol completion
steps.instruction: Observe the robot lights flashing on and off to indicate the protocol has finished.
